main.description: A monthly membership plan offered by the account (the creator). Members pay the price in USDC on Base straight to a wallet the creator linked; Krao takes no fee and holds no funds. At most 3 plans of an account count as active; the indexer treats further active plans as inactive.

priceUsdc.description: Price of 30 days of membership in USDC base units (6 decimals) as a decimal integer string, from 1000000 ($1) to 1000000000 ($1000).

active.description: Whether new members can join or renew. Existing memberships run until they expire.
